_comment: Copy to pdfscan.json beside your PDFs, or at your repository root, and
delete the keys you do not need. Every key is documented in
references/config.md. JSON has no comments, so this one is a key the
scanner rejects - remove the _comment block before use, which is also
a cheap check that the scanner is reading the file you think it is.
Severity order: critical > warn > review > info.
fail_on is the level that exits 2.
